name: Slugger Park
hook: Backyard baseball. Pick your pitch, time your swing.
how: Pitch a fastball, curve or changeup to a spot in or out of the zone. At bat, put the ring on the ball and swing as it arrives: timing and placement decide whiff, foul, grounder, liner, fly or home run.
controls: Mouse to aim the ring or the pitch, click or Space to swing or throw, 1 2 3 pick a pitch · touch: drag to aim, SWING / PITCH buttons
uses: The host's browser runs the fielders, throws, runners, outs and innings; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill every empty spot, so even alone you play a full four-a-side game.
Each player's most home runs in one game, shown on the results card.
Every pitch, swing, catch and run plays out the same on every screen.
ideas: Make it a night game under the lights with a glowing ball
Add a knuckleball that wobbles on the way in
Let the batter bunt by holding the swing button
